system.description:
While in Stealth, entering an enemy's line of sight doesn't end Stealth outright: make an Opposed Wit Check against the enemy. If it fails, you stay in Stealth.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.41
system.summary: While in Stealth, entering an enemy's line of sight doesn't end Stealth outright: make an Opposed Wit Check against the enemy. If it fails, you stay in Stealth.

automation.label: Opposed Wit vs the enemy
automation.onSuccess: The enemy fails to spot you; you stay in Stealth.
automation.onFail: The enemy spots you; Stealth ends.

automation.note: Roll whenever you enter an enemy's line of sight while in Stealth. Opposed: the Director rolls the enemy's Wit and sets the CR to beat its successes (ties are the Director's call, p12). Failure removes your Stealth status automatically.
